                      [32m'[`stateful_map`](https://docs.bytewax.io/v0.19.1/api/bytewax/bytewax.operators.html#bytewax.operators.stateful_map "bytewax.operators.stateful_map") is, as the name implies, a stateful operator. [`stateful_map`](https://docs.bytewax.io/v0.19.1/api/bytewax/bytewax.operators.html#bytewax.operators.stateful_map "bytewax.operators.stateful_map") takes four parameters: a `step_id`, a [`Stream`](https://docs.bytewax.io/v0.19.1/api/bytewax/bytewax.dataflow.html#bytewax.dataflow.Stream "bytewax.dataflow.Stream") of input data, a **builder** function, and a **mapper** function.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'The **mapper** function should return a 2-tuple of `(updated_state, emit_value)`. The `updated_state` that is returned from this function is the internal state of this operator, and will be used for recovery. The `emit_value` will be passed downstream.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Let’s see a concrete example. Add the following code in a new file named `recovery.py`:\n'[39m +
